rules: Organizer and official institutional sources prioritized; race listing estimates labelled separately.
Do not carry old-edition GPX, routes or dates into 2027 without confirmation.
A GPX download control or course map does not count as a downloaded and parsed binary.
Distinguish official D+ from third-party ascent estimates and min/max elevation ranges.
Audit-only; no live event records or runtime files changed.

events.name: 42. Plitvički Maraton
events.detail: Plitvice Lakes National Park authority decision confirms 42nd Plitvički Maraton on 5–6 June 2027 and publishes a course corridor Mukinje–Drežničko Selište–Poljanak–Plitvički Ljeskovac–Velika Poljana–Mukinje. Runners.hr lists distances and ascent estimates (marathon +1100m, half +506m, 9km +263m, 5km +146m); these metrics are race-listing data, not organizer-published GPX validation. Do not treat the 9km race as a 10km.

events.name: 40th Powerade Belgrade Marathon / European Running Championships
events.detail: AIMS lists 40th Powerade Belgrade Marathon 17–18 April 2027. Official European Running Championships registration gives half 17 April 09:00, 10K 17 April 18:00, marathon 18 April 08:00. Trke Srbija event listing gives marathon 399m ascent but explicitly says this is organizer-entered information and GPX-derived ascent is not yet available. Course is also part of European Running Championships 2027.

events.name: Timișoara 21K by SportGuru
events.detail: Official organizer page confirms 21 March 2027, 09:00, start Piața Libertății, two laps, time limit 3h. The page provides an official regulation and course section but no GPX binary/elevation figure was validated.
events.gpxStatus: course map section available; no 2027 binary downloaded or parsed

events.name: Alba Iulia City Race
events.detail: Official event homepage confirms 13 March 2027 and registration. The retrieved homepage does not provide confirmed 2027 race distances, course maps, start times or elevation; do not infer them from earlier editions.

events.name: DZI Marathon Stara Zagora
events.detail: DZI official announcement dated 17 September 2026 confirms Stara Zagora marathon will carry the DZI brand from 2027 under a three-year partnership. No specific 2027 race date, distances, route or GPX located in this check. Do not copy the 2026 Stara Zagora event date/course.

events.name: Sofia Half Marathon
events.detail: Official organizer page confirms 4 April 2027, seventh edition. Half marathon 21.1km starts 09:00; 5K and 10K start 09:10. Organizer says all routes are World Athletics certified and publishes a combined route map. No GPX binary downloaded/parsed and no ascent figure given.

events.name: Plovdiv Run – Marathon Weekend
events.detail: Organizer confirms 16–18 April 2027. Marathon, half and 10K on Sunday 18 April; 5K Saturday 17 April. Half course one lap, marathon two laps. Half elevation gain shown as 17m; course certification to World Athletics/AIMS standards valid through 31 Dec 2031 if course unchanged. Official GPX download button exists. Binary not downloaded/parsed in this audit.

events.name: Sri Chinmoy Run and Become Marathon
events.detail: Organizer Run and Become AC confirms first official marathon on 2 May 2027 at South Park, Sofia, 07:00. Course is a 2km asphalt loop; marathon 21 laps, half 10.5 laps, 5K 2.5 laps; time limit 6h. No official elevation or GPX binary found.

events.name: DZI Marathon Varna
events.detail: DZI official announcement confirms Varna marathon will carry DZI branding from 2027 as part of a three-year partnership. No specific 2027 date, distances, route or GPX located in this check. Keep 2026 edition details historical only.

events.name: NLB RMC Banja Luka Half Marathon
events.detail: Organizer page confirms 23 May 2027, 08:00, 21,000m, two laps, start/finish at Banja Luka Arena, flat course measured and verified by AIMS. The rules text contains a stale year 2025 despite page date 2027; preserve this content inconsistency and request corrected rulebook. No GPX binary or ascent metric found.

followUps: Plitvice: obtain official 2027 course GPX for marathon, half, 9km and 5km; listing D+ estimates are not binary validated.
Belgrade: request official championship GPX files for marathon, half and 10K; 399m marathon ascent is only organizer-entered estimate.
Timisoara: download and parse official 21K GPX; check two-lap course and 21km stated distance.
Alba Iulia: await 2027 race categories, regulations and route publication.
Stara Zagora and Varna: DZI brand announced for 2027 but dates and routes not yet located; do not invent or reuse 2026 data.
Sofia Half: retrieve individual 21.1/10/5K GPX and parse; published map alone is not binary validation.
Plovdiv: download official GPX for each course and parse; half D+17m published, not binary verified; marathon is two half laps.
Sri Chinmoy Sofia: request GPX and verify loop geometry; all races use a 2km asphalt loop.
Banja Luka: request corrected 2027 rulebook because page date says 2027 but embedded rules show 2025; download GPX and parse two loops.
